jobs.prompt: Fix a review finding on tests/burst-gpu.test.mjs's new scaler timing test (T-0422). The test 'long queue sustains 10 minutes before start, then idle 10 minutes before stop' builds its boundary offsets from the imported DEFAULT_START_SUSTAIN_MS and IDLE_STOP_MS constants (tools/burst-gpu-scale.mjs, read as context) rather than literal values, so it only checks internal consistency - if those constants were accidentally changed from their spec'd 10-minute value, the test would silently pass against the new (wrong) value instead of catching the regression. Fix: add two explicit assertions near the top of that test (or describe block) pinning the actual spec'd values: `assert.equal(DEFAULT_START_SUSTAIN_MS, 600_000)` and `assert.equal(IDLE_STOP_MS, 600_000)` (10 minutes in ms), so a future change to either constant away from 10 minutes fails this test directly, in addition to the existing relative-boundary checks. Run the test file when done.
